description:
Arc 62 build coordination — land MAJOR_HAMILTON, the design-time WORKFLOW architect (peer to CHIRON). Reactivation target for the standing POLYBIUS_the-stoa (floor-manager) + PLINY_the-stoa (orchestrator) after the Arc 61 close.

SPEC SOURCES (read first): stoa--yh2 (charter) + the "MAJOR_HAMILTON charter" comment on stoa--p41 (2026-06-16). TEMPLATE: Arc 61 just landed CHIRON on main @24b79cc — use substrate/MAJOR_CHIRON.md + docs/major-chiron.html + the install.sh CHIRON deploy wiring as the STRUCTURAL template. HAMILTON mirrors CHIRON's SHAPE (a design-time MAJOR seat) but its DOMAIN is choreography (workflows), not cast (roster).

WHO HAMILTON IS:
- MAJOR-tier, design-time, PEER to CHIRON. Answers to POLYBIUS; does NOT command PLINY. Hook: Margaret Hamilton (Apollo flight software; coined "software engineering"; fault-tolerant orchestration). ADA's computing lineage (roster balance ADA + HAMILTON).
- Division: CHIRON designs the CAST (which seats); HAMILTON designs the CHOREOGRAPHY (how their work flows). They CO-DESIGN — co-constrain + iterate together, not strict sequence.
- DOMAIN: (1) Anthropic dynamic workflows — the Claude Code Workflow tool / Agent SDK: orchestration scripts, subagent fan-out, the context-isolation cascade (Opus orchestrator calls a Python tool that invokes a cheaper model; only the output returns). (2) bw workflows — tickets, dependencies, polling cadence, orphan-branch sync, the seat-identity / Co-Authored-By trailer convention. (3) INTEGRATION — the seam between Anthropic-workflow execution and bw coordination (her distinctive value).
- OUTPUT: the workflow design for a team CHIRON has cast — orchestration scripts + the bw coordination contract + the runtime model-cascade topology (which steps are deterministic code / cheap model / Opus; where context isolation applies; sentinel->Stoa escalation paths). Owns the WORKFLOW side of the two-layer runtime architecture (CHIRON owns the roster side).
- TOOLING: holds the workflow-composer skill + bw-workflow expertise. (MAJOR_CHIRON.md §9 already states "You do not hold workflow-composer (HAMILTON's)" — this build makes that real.)

DELIVERABLES (D1–D5 — MOSTLY-ADDITIVE; NO retirement/relocation cascade):
D1. Author substrate/MAJOR_HAMILTON.md — the seat. Mirror MAJOR_CHIRON.md structure + voice. Cover: identity/tier, the CHIRON-peer division + co-design, the 3-part domain, the OUTPUT deliverable, workflow-composer tooling, model-cascade/context-isolation literacy, voice discipline (PRINCIPAL/HUMAN throughout; no COLONEL leak; no second-person framing of the human).
D2. Render docs/major-hamilton.html — rendered view mirroring docs/major-chiron.html (Stoa aesthetic, section nav, <meta name="author" content="Denson Smith">, footer attribution).
D3. Wire install.sh deploy — deploy MAJOR_HAMILTON at ALL tiers, suffixed HAMILTON_<slug> at project/subproject, parallel to CHIRON/POLYBIUS/PLINY (DEST_HAMILTON + deploy lines in the §2 MAJOR-deploy block + SRC_HAMILTON existence guard). HAMILTON owns NO module -> NO recompose ownership-partition entry + NO MODULE-INLINE marker; CONFIRM the FAIL-LOUD recompose stays green (zero owned modules = no Check-B/D trip).
D4. App regen — gen-data ingests MAJOR_HAMILTON as a 4th MAJOR. Update app/src/data/__tests__/generated.test.ts MAJOR-set assertion -> [CHIRON, HAMILTON, PLINY, POLYBIUS] (currently [CHIRON, PLINY, POLYBIUS]); re-run npm run gen-data and STAGE the regenerated app/src/data/generated/agents.ts in the SAME commit; npm run build && npm test green.
D5. Cross-refs — add the reciprocal HAMILTON<->CHIRON co-design pointer (CHIRON already names HAMILTON; ensure HAMILTON names CHIRON). Frame workflow-composer as HAMILTON's tool. Check any substrate roster doc enumerating the MAJORs (agent-cards index already has HAMILTON).

DoD:
- substrate/install.sh --target user --dry-run passes AND a REAL (non-dry-run) subproject recompose into a throwaway dir stays green. ARC-61 LESSON (load-bearing): a --dry-run early-returns at install.sh ~L1046 BEFORE the awk FAIL-LOUD Checks A–E (~L1051) — verify with a REAL recompose, never a dry-run.
- cd app && npm run gen-data && npm run build && npm test all green (4 MAJORs).
- Voice audit on MAJOR_HAMILTON.md (colonel only reserved-rank; no "the user").
- Authorship: MAJOR_HAMILTON.md + docs/major-hamilton.html meta+footer = Denson Smith; no false-person author field. Commit Author=PRINCIPAL + Co-Authored-By: CAPTAIN_ADA_the-stoa trailer.
- NOMOS CONFORMANT on the final commit. Committed + pushed to the-stoa main; this epic updated with the landing SHA.

OUT OF SCOPE: the OTHER p41 skill re-homings (check-substrate-updates/check-bw-release -> SessionStart; save-verdict/validate-spec/inspect-script-output -> modules; credential-discipline) — that is the SEPARATE skills-housekeeping pass AFTER this. The authorship-gate bug (stoa--z2b) + the-stoa self-apply (stoa--ruu) — separate.

GAUNTLET: full DAEDALUS -> ARGUS -> ADA -> VERA -> CATO -> NOMOS. Lighter than Arc 61 (additive, no cascade) but touches canon + install.sh + app -> gauntlet-appropriate. Surface design-lock to floor-manager before ADA.

CHAIN: PRINCIPAL -> user-tier POLYBIUS (close-gate + merge) -> POLYBIUS_the-stoa (floor-manager: independent verify + relay) -> PLINY_the-stoa (orchestrator: dispatches CAPTAINs). Per-seat engagement instructions in the two comments below.
